terms.comment: L&S records “a kind of fire-engine” (Plin. Ep. 10.33, numbered 10.42 in L&S; Dig.). Morgan–Owens uses sīphō for a fire hydrant.

phrases.latin: Sīphō ruber est, scālīs longīs īnstrūctus.
phrases.english: The fire engine is red, with long ladders on it.

sources: Lewis & Short: sipho
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 167, 315.
